sum: PS International Group Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates as a freight forwarding service provider worldwide. It provides air freight services, including domestic, deferred, express, and charter services; port-to-port and door-to-door shipments; air and transload shipping services; and transport of sensitive, perishable, and refrigerated goods. The company also offers ocean freight services, such as ocean freight consolidation, direct ocean forwarding, and order management services, as well as ancillary logistics and warehousing related services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. PS International Group Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Grand Pro Development Limited.
